title: Plumbing Marketing Ideas That Actually Work | Podium

facts.fact: The Podium article '15 Plumbing Marketing Ideas, Strategies, and Tips That Actually Work' is dated February 1, 2021.
The article gives an estimated read time of 12 minutes.
The article's title and content present 15 plumbing marketing ideas, strategies, and tips.
facts.quote: 15 Plumbing Marketing Ideas, Strategies, and Tips That Actually Work

facts.fact: Podium states that plumbing customers are mostly limited to those within a probable thirty to fifty-mile radius of the business location (Podium's own estimate, not a sourced statistic).
facts.quote: Your customers are mostly limited to those local to (probably within a thirty to fifty-mile radius) your business location.

facts.fact: Per research by LeadPages and Infusionsoft cited by Podium, 47 percent of small business owners, including plumbing company owners, handle their marketing efforts on their own.
facts.quote: reveals that 47 percent of small business owners, such as plumbing company owners, handle marketing efforts and initiatives on their own.
